blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A known pro-Duterte vlogger who is a native of Cebu was reportedly shot dead while driving along a national highway in Carrascal, Surigao del Sur Sunday morning, October 4. According to local media reports, the victim was identified as Philip Engbino, 48, married, a native of Minglanilla, Cebu. Engbino is reportedly a manager of EZMMI GenCon, a contractor of Strong Group Mining Corp. (SGMC). He was an active social media vlogger supportive of former President Rodrigo Duterte.
